items.subject: A warm intro ask via your paper with Rebecca Abergel
items.body:
Hi Åsmund,

I’m Hannah Weber of HOPO Therapeutics. You co-authored "Solution Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Metal Complexation with a Hydroxypyridinone Chelator Designed for Thorium-227 Targeted Alpha Therapy" with Rebecca Abergel in 2018; we’re turning her Berkeley Lab molecule into a pill that clears radioactive metals and lead. Would you be open to a short call, or to pointing me to the team working on contrast-agent safety research? No worries if not.

Hannah

Note you can forward:
Hannah Weber of HOPO Therapeutics would value a short call with the team working on contrast-agent safety research at Bayer (Germany). HOPO develops an oral chelator from Rebecca Abergel’s Berkeley Lab research.
